summary: Frontend-only test of Quick Entry > Log Payment student picker, the auto-opening New Payment dialog (?pay=1), and mobile (390x844) padding/topbar on 9 pages, plus a desktop 1920x800 regression check. The picker flow fully works on desktop and mobile. Two mobile issues remain: (1) page titles in the topbar are cut off on most pages, including 'Students'; (2) /branding scrolls sideways by 36px.

ui_bugs.issue: Title area is only ~70px wide, so titles get cut off with an ellipsis: 'Students', 'Overview', 'Messages', 'Quick e…', 'Custo…' (Customize), 'Expense requests', and the 'WORKSP…' label. Only Settings, Student and Clients fit. On the right, year selector + bell + messages + avatar take up 234px (x 140 to 374). Nothing overlaps and the topbar does not overflow, but the 'Students/Settings readable' requirement is only partly met.

The page scrolls sideways: page width 426px vs 390px viewport. The branding form card is 410px wide inside a 358px container. Cause: the outer 'grid lg:grid-cols-5' has no grid-cols-1 or min-w-0, so its single column stretches to the widest content (the logo row: file input + 'Remove' button, which does not wrap). The right side of the inputs and the 'Remove' button are cut off.

issues: The 'Balance' shown in the picker (balance_vs_scheduled, e.g. ₹2,90,000) differs from the 'Balance vs SC earned' tile on the student page (₹0). Consider labelling it 'Due vs schedule' to avoid confusion.
Date field uses the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn calendar (this existed before this change).

action_items: Branding.jsx line 100: change to 'grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-6' and add min-w-0 to the branding-form card and the preview card. Add flex-wrap and min-w-0 to the logo row (file input + Remove) so it wraps at 390px.

AppShell topbar on mobile: make room for the title. Options: show the year selector as icon-only or with a shorter label below sm; hide the topbar messages button below sm, since the drawer/bottom nav already reach it; reduce gap-1.5; or let the title wrap / use text-sm. Goal: 'Students', 'Overview', 'Messages', 'Quick entry' fully readable at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: StudentPickerDialog loads all students (/students) every time it opens, with no limit or debounce. Fine for small tenants; consider server-side search with a limit for large ones.
StudentPickerDialog does not reset list to null when it reopens, so data from the last open shows briefly. Minor.
StudentDetail ?pay=1 effect is correct: it opens once, removes the param with replace, and is declared before the early return.

success_rate.frontend: 85% - picker flow 100%; mobile layout 7 of 9 pages OK (branding overflows); topbar title partially fails

seed_data_creation: None. No payments were saved; the dialog was only opened and closed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login admin@educonnect.app / Admin@12345 (skip the PIN popup with data-testid=pin-setup-skip). The only student is Nayana Biju, id 372fcdd9-ac53-40f8-a44f-f1fb8d510b93, reference 'Suhail'. Verified: the picker opens, search is focused automatically, search works by name and reference, a no-match search shows student-picker-empty, and picking a student goes to /students/{id}, where the New Payment dialog opens and the ?pay param is removed. After Escape the page still works (the open-pay button reopens the dialog), and a refresh does not reopen it. Mobile .mobile-pad is 16px on each side; cards use 20px padding (a few use 16 or 24px by design). Page content ends at y=732, above the bottom nav at ~780. No horizontal overflow except /branding. Desktop topbar and layout look fine. Retest: /branding overflow and mobile topbar title width.
rca of the issue: Branding overflow: a CSS grid with no explicit columns makes one 'auto' column sized to the widest content. The logo row (native file input + Remove) needs ~410px, so the card pushes past the viewport. Topbar truncation: the right cluster is shrink-0 and takes 234px of the 358px usable width; with the menu button (36px) and gaps, only ~70px is left for the title.
